answers.name: Azide-alkyne Huisgen cycloaddition
answers.blurb: Sounds deeply obscure, but its copper-catalysed version is the flagship of click chemistry, which won the 2022 Nobel Prize. Plenty of chemists will say it.

answers.name: Strecker degradation
answers.blurb: Turns an amino acid into an aldehyde with one carbon fewer. It's part of the Maillard browning chemistry behind the smell of baking bread, roasting coffee and chocolate.
